title: Dealing with living wills by medical and non-medical emergency service personnel in the context of out-of-hospital cardiovascular arrest
summary: Within the framework of the study project, knowledge is to be gained about how medical and non-medical rescue service personnel deal with living wills during resuscitation operations, what influence a living will has during operations and where difficulties lie in decision-making. Subsequently, a possible need for further training can be derived from this and concrete further training measures can be designed based on this. This can lead to an increased awareness of the topic, so that ideally the individual patient's will is given greater consideration.

interventions.name: Medical and non-medical emergency service personnel

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Employee at DRK Rettungsdienst Mittelhessen gGmbH
Age ≥ 18 years
Involvement in a resuscitation situation
Living will presented or requested by the rescue team
Exclusion criteria:
Not an employee of DRK Rettungsdienst Mittelhessen gGmbH
Age < 18 years
No living will known in the context of the resuscitation situation
